# citrix — 2020 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 34 citrix CVEs of 2020 are in `data/cve/vendors/citrix/2020.jsonl`.

### CVE-2020-8193
- Assigner: hackerone | Published: 2020-07-10 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 6.5
- CWE: CWE-284 Improper Access Control - Generic (CWE-284)
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 6.5 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial
- **CISA KEV**: added 2021-11-03, ransomware=Unknown — Citrix ADC, Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance Authorization Bypass Vulnerability

Improper access control in Citrix ADC and Citrix Gateway versions before 13.0-58.30, 12.1-57.18, 12.0-63.21, 11.1-64.14 and 10.5-70.18 and Citrix SDWAN WAN-OP versions before 11.1.1a, 11.0.3d and 10.2.7 allows unauthenticated access to certain URL endpoints.

Affected:
- n/a / Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, Citrix SDWAN WAN-OP: affected Citrix ADC and Citrix Gateway 13.0-58.30, 12.1-57.18, 12.0-63.21, 11.1-64.14 and 10.5-70.18 and Citrix SDWAN WAN-OP 11.1.1a, 11.0.3d and 10.2.7

References:
- https://support.citrix.com/article/CTX276688 [x_refsource_MISC]
- http://packetstormsecurity.com/files/160047/Citrix-ADC-NetScaler-Local-File-Inclusion.html [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?field_cve=CVE-2020-8193 [government-resource]

### CVE-2020-13998
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2020-06-11 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: n/a; CWE-639 CWE-639 Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

Citrix XenApp 6.5, when 2FA is enabled, allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to ascertain whether a user exists on the server, because the 2FA error page only occurs after a valid username is entered. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
- citrix / xenapp: affected 6.5.0.0
